rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for turning ingredients into an emulsion, especially in cooking or technical contexts.

example.english: Slowly whisk the egg yolk, oil, and vinegar to emulsify them into a salad dressing.
example.traditional: 將蛋黃、油同醋慢慢打勻，乳化成沙律醬。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 daan2 wong2 jau4 tung4 cou3 maan6 maan6 daa2 wan4 jyu5 faa3 sing4 saa1 leot6 zoeng3
